name: How do open shelves compare to closed cabinets for bathroom storage?

mainEntity.name: How do open shelves compare to closed cabinets for bathroom storage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open shelving provides easy access for daily essentials and creates an airy, modern aesthetic, but it requires regular dusting and deliberate styling to avoid looking cluttered. Enclosed cabinetry conceals toiletries, extra paper products, and cleaning supplies, keeping the room visually tidy and protecting contents from bathroom humidity. A common tradeoff is accessibility versus maintenance: open shelves demand disciplined organization, while closed cabinets take up more visual weight in smaller rooms. Many homeowners balance both by using closed vanity drawers for personal items and a single open wood shelf for decorative items or rolled hand towels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Open shelving keeps items accessible and feels visually light but gathers dust, whereas closed cabinetry hides clutter and protects items from steam.
